list.label: Customer orders
list.hint: An order is made at the till (Esc menu, "Make it an order") or from a validated quote ("Turn into an order").

dialog.title: Make it an order
dialog.orderHint: The goods are delivered or served later.
dialog.layawayHint: The goods are set aside and handed over once fully paid.
dialog.dueInvalid: Choose today or a later date.

page.readyDone: The order is ready: let the customer know.
page.deliverBody: A delivery note with the order's lines is validated; the deposit held goes on the customer's account.
page.invoiceBody: An invoice is validated on the customer's account; the deposit held pays part of it.
page.keepBody: The customer gave up: the shop keeps the deposit. It is sold on a "Kept deposit" receipt and the order is closed. A manager must allow it.
page.kept: Deposit kept: the receipt is printing.
page.closeBody: The order is called off and the reserved stock is released.
page.heldHint: Refund the deposit or keep it before closing.
page.layawayHint: A layaway is paid in full before it is handed over, never on credit.

fulfil.loaded: Order {{number}} at the till: {{held}} of deposit already paid, take the rest.
fulfil.layaway: Layaway {{number}} at the till: the rest is paid now, never on credit.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.durationRange: Enter a duration between 5 and 600 minutes.
